newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lamfalussy-euro money supply may be hard to read.
newsitem.headline: Lamfalussy-euro money supply may be hard to read.

text.p: European Monetary Institute President Alexandre Lamfalussy said it would take six months to two years before money supply data for the entire Euro area could give a reliable picture of devlopments.
Lamfalussy made the comments to reporters at the International Business Journalists Forum on Monday evening.

"It will probably take between six months and two years before you get a picture of how it will look," Lamfalussy said. The European Monetary Institute had run simulations, "but they are only simulations," he added.
The main problem lay not in obtaining the data, but in knowing how to interpret it.
"It is not a question of having the figures, but of having the meaning of them," he said.
